fish: Central Fresh Fish Outlet (buying is allowed)

howItemsArrive: Any way the items get into the runner's pack after the start counts: gathering at the sources, buying fish at the Central Fresh Fish Outlet, or anything cleverer. A run that games the course in an interesting way has earned the prize.
clockStart: the runner left the start area after the last reading that shows them in it (the earliest possible start) and by the first reading that shows them out of it (the latest possible start)
baseline: item counts at the last reading that shows the runner in the start area
finish: every item count above its baseline count
timing: the run lasted at most (finish reading - last reading in the start area) and at least (reading before the finish reading - first reading out of it). seconds = the shortest possible time, but never more than maxTotalGapBenefitSeconds below the longest possible time
parSource: kwigbo's own action log of his practice run, see par.md

readings.source: Midnight City public observer, via record.mjs
readings.interval: normally 5 to 15 seconds apart; a slow observer can make gaps longer
readings.time: t is taken when the observer's answer arrives
